Currently when XDP rings are created
column2: each descriptor gets its DD bit
which turns out to be the wrong approach as it can lead to a

column1: situation where more descriptors get cleaned than it was supposed to
e.g. when AF_XDP busy poll is run with a large batch size. In this

column2: the driver would request for more buffers than it is able to

column1: Fix this by not setting the DD bits in ice_xdp_alloc_setup_rings(). They
should be initialized to zero instead.
